title.zh: 先保证每个长度的配分和严格为正
title.en: First establish positivity at every length

given.zh: 长度固定时自避游走集合有限；$\rho > 0$，指数权重 $\exp(s \cdot \operatorname{Re}(\overline{e} \cdot \Delta\gamma))$ 始终为正。
given.en: At fixed length there are finitely many self-avoiding walks; $\rho > 0$ and every exponential weight $\exp(s \cdot \operatorname{Re}(\overline{e} \cdot \Delta\gamma))$ is positive.

claim.zh: 任意 $o$ 和 $n$ 都有 $Z_o(n) > 0$，因此后面可对配分和不等式取对数，并使用 $\log(ab) = \log a + \log b$。
claim.en: For every $o$ and $n$, $Z_o(n) > 0$. We may therefore take logarithms of partition inequalities and use $\log(ab) = \log a + \log b$.

statement.en: $\mathrm{rank}(\gamma_j) = \mathrm{rank}(o) + j$, so $\gamma_j \ne \gamma_k$ whenever $j \ne k$.

reason.zh: 取 spine 的前 $n$ 步；每走一步 spineRank 增加一，所以不可能重复经过某个顶点。
reason.en: Take the first $n$ spine steps. Each increases spineRank by one, preventing any repeated vertex.

statement.en: The weight of this $\gamma$ is $\rho^n \exp(s \cdot \operatorname{Re}(\overline{e} \cdot \Delta\gamma)) > 0$.

reason.zh: $\rho$ 是正数，任意实数的指数也严格为正；$n = 0$ 时同样得到一项权重为一的空游走。
reason.en: The factor $\rho$ is positive and a real exponential is strictly positive. At $n = 0$ the empty walk contributes weight one.

statement.zh: $Z_o(n) \ge \mathrm{weight}(\gamma) > 0$，后面所有 $\log Z_o(n)$ 都有正的真数。
statement.en: $Z_o(n) \ge \mathrm{weight}(\gamma) > 0$, so every later $\log Z_o(n)$ has a positive argument.

reason.zh: $\gamma$ 属于有限求和集合，且其它权重非负，保留这一项就得到严格正下界。
reason.en: The walk $\gamma$ belongs to the finite summation set and all other weights are nonnegative, so retaining this term gives strict positivity.

title.zh: 同类起点的配分和完全相同
title.en: Starting points in the same class have identical partition sums

given.zh: 两个起点 $o$、$o'$ 的 up 标记相同，则它们相差一个整格平移。
given.en: If $o$ and $o'$ have the same up flag, an integer lattice translation takes one to the other.

claim.zh: 对所有 $n$，$Z_o(n) = Z_{o'}(n)$。后续只需保留两个标准起点 $\mathrm{up}(0,0)$ 和 $\mathrm{down}(0,0)$。
claim.en: For every $n$, $Z_o(n) = Z_{o'}(n)$. It is enough to retain the two representatives $\mathrm{up}(0,0)$ and $\mathrm{down}(0,0)$.

statement.zh: 选整格向量 $z$ 使 $T_z(o) = o'$，并对游走逐点作 $T_z$。
statement.en: Choose an integer lattice vector $z$ with $T_z(o) = o'$ and translate each vertex of a walk by $T_z$.

reason.zh: 同类起点具有相同的 up 标记，位置之差恰由整格平移实现；平移保持每条邻接边。
reason.en: The equal up flags make the displacement an integer lattice translation, which preserves every adjacency.

statement.en: $T_{-z} \circ T_z = \mathrm{id}$ and $\Delta(T_z\gamma) = (\mathrm{endpoint} + z) - (\mathrm{start} + z) = \Delta\gamma$.

reason.zh: 逆平移同时还原顶点互异性与整条路径；起终点增加的 $z$ 在位移中抵消。
reason.en: Inverse translation recovers the whole path and preserves distinctness. The added $z$ cancels from the endpoint-minus-start displacement.

statement.en: $\mathrm{weight}(T_z\gamma) = \mathrm{weight}(\gamma)$, hence reindexing the sum gives $Z_o(n) = Z_{o'}(n)$.

reason.zh: 长度和位移都没有改变，配分和的两个参数也相同，因此双射下每个求和项逐一相等。
reason.en: Length, displacement and parameters remain unchanged, so corresponding terms are equal under the bijection of walk sets.

title.zh: 拆分游走，把长配分和压到乘积下面
title.en: Split a walk to bound a long partition sum by a product

given.zh: 把 $m + n$ 步自避游走 $\gamma$ 拆成前 $m$ 步 $\alpha$ 与从其中间顶点出发的后 $n$ 步 $\beta$。
given.en: Split an $(m+n)$-step self-avoiding walk $\gamma$ into an $m$-step prefix $\alpha$ and an $n$-step suffix $\beta$ starting at the intermediate vertex.

statement.en: The split $\gamma \mapsto (\alpha, \beta)$ is injective, with $\Delta\gamma = \Delta\alpha + \Delta\beta$.

reason.zh: 保留前 $m$ 步和后 $n$ 步就能恢复全部顶点；中间顶点在两段的位移相加时抵消。
reason.en: The prefix and suffix determine all vertices of $\gamma$, and the intermediate vertex cancels when their displacements are added.

statement.en: $\rho^{m+n}\exp(s \cdot \mathrm{proj}(\Delta\alpha + \Delta\beta)) = \mathrm{weight}(\alpha) \cdot \mathrm{weight}(\beta)$.

reason.zh: 投影对位移可加，再用 $\rho^{m+n} = \rho^m\rho^n$ 和 $\exp(a+b) = \exp(a)\exp(b)$ 分开权重。
reason.en: The projection is additive; powers and the exponential of a sum then factor the weight into the two segment weights.

statement.en: $Z_o(m+n) \le \sum_\alpha \mathrm{weight}(\alpha) \cdot Z_{\mathrm{endpoint}(\alpha)}(n)$.

reason.zh: 把后缀扩展到所有从中点出发的自避游走，会加入一些与前缀相交的组合。新增项非负，因此给出上界。
reason.en: Allow every self-avoiding suffix from the intermediate vertex, including suffixes meeting the prefix. The added terms are nonnegative, so this enlarges the sum.

statement.en: $Z_{\mathrm{endpoint}(\alpha)}(n) \le M_n = \max\{Z_{\mathrm{up}}(n), Z_{\mathrm{down}}(n)\}$, giving $Z_o(m+n) \le Z_o(m) M_n$.

reason.zh: 每个中点属于两类之一，同类平移把其配分和换成相应标准值；公共上界 $M_n$ 可以提出前缀求和。
reason.en: Each intermediate vertex belongs to one of the two classes. Translation replaces its sum by the representative value, and the common bound $M_n$ factors out of the prefix sum.

title.zh: 偶数步回到同类，得到真正的次可加性
title.en: Even prefixes return to the same class and give subadditivity

given.zh: 蜂窝图每走一条边都会翻转 up 标记，因此任意 $2p$ 步前缀的终点与 $c$ 同类。
given.en: Every honeycomb edge flips the up flag, so the endpoint of a $2p$-step prefix has the same class as $c$.

claim.zh: $Z_c(2(p+q)) \le Z_c(2p) Z_c(2q)$，故 $u_{p+q} \le u_p + u_q$，其中 $u_p = \log Z_c(2p)$。up、down 两类分别满足这个结论。
claim.en: $Z_c(2(p+q)) \le Z_c(2p) Z_c(2q)$, hence $u_{p+q} \le u_p + u_q$ for $u_p = \log Z_c(2p)$. This holds separately for both up and down classes.

statement.en: $\mathrm{up}(\mathrm{endpoint}(\alpha)) = \mathrm{up}(c)$ whenever $\alpha$ has length $2p$.

reason.zh: 每条蜂窝图边翻转一次标记，偶数次翻转回到原标记，与前缀的具体形状无关。
reason.en: Each edge flips the flag once, so an even number of flips restores it regardless of the prefix shape.

statement.en: $Z_{\mathrm{endpoint}(\alpha)}(2q) = Z_c(2q)$, hence $Z_c(2p+2q) \le Z_c(2p) Z_c(2q)$.

reason.zh: 前一步的拆分和中，每个后缀因子现在都等于同一个标准值，因此直接提出该值，不再需要最大值。
reason.en: Every suffix factor in the split sum now equals the same representative value, so it can be factored out without taking a maximum.

statement.en: $u_{p+q} = \log Z_c(2(p+q)) \le \log Z_c(2p) + \log Z_c(2q) = u_p + u_q$.

reason.zh: 两因子严格为正，允许用 $\log$ 的单调性及乘积公式；对 up 和 down 分别应用同一计算。
reason.en: Both factors are positive, so monotonicity of $\log$ and its product formula apply. Perform this calculation separately for up and down.

title.zh: 一条直线游走阻止对数增长率掉到负无穷
title.en: One explicit walk prevents the logarithmic rate from falling to minus infinity

given.zh: 从任一标准起点 $c$ 沿 spine 走 $2p$ 步，终点相对起点的位移是实数 $p$；该游走没有重复顶点。
given.en: The spine walk of length $2p$ from either representative $c$ has displacement $p$ along the real axis and has no repeated vertices.

claim.zh: $Z_c(2p) \ge \rho^{2p} \exp(-|s| p |\operatorname{Re} e|)$，所以对 $p \ge 1$ 有 $u_p/p \ge 2\log\rho - |s||\operatorname{Re} e|$。

statement.zh: 选 $2p$ 步 spine 游走 $\gamma$，则 $\Delta\gamma = p$，投影为 $p \cdot \operatorname{Re} e$。
statement.en: Choose the $2p$-step spine walk $\gamma$. Then $\Delta\gamma = p$ and its projection is $p \cdot \operatorname{Re} e$.

reason.zh: 源码分别计算了 up、down 起点的偶数步终点；两种情形减去各自起点后都得到实位移 $p$。
reason.en: The source computes the even-step endpoint for each starting class. Subtracting its respective starting position gives real displacement $p$ in both cases.

statement.zh: $s \cdot p \cdot \operatorname{Re} e \ge -|s \cdot p \cdot \operatorname{Re} e| = -|s| p |\operatorname{Re} e|$。
statement.en: $s \cdot p \cdot \operatorname{Re} e \ge -|s \cdot p \cdot \operatorname{Re} e| = -|s| p |\operatorname{Re} e|$.

reason.zh: 使用实数总不小于其绝对值的相反数，再用 $p \ge 0$ 去掉 $|p|$。这对任意正负参数 $s$ 都成立。
reason.en: Every real number is at least minus its absolute value. Since $p \ge 0$, $|p| = p$; the inequality allows either sign of $s$.

statement.en: $Z_c(2p) \ge \mathrm{weight}(\gamma) \ge \rho^{2p} \exp(-|s| p |\operatorname{Re} e|)$.

reason.zh: 先用单个求和项下估配分和，再用指数函数的单调性把上一行代入权重。
reason.en: Bound the sum below by one term, then use monotonicity of the exponential to apply the preceding inequality to its weight.

statement.zh: $p \ge 1$ 时 $u_p/p \ge 2\log\rho - |s||\operatorname{Re} e|$；加入 $p = 0$ 后可统一用 $\min\{0, 2\log\rho - |s||\operatorname{Re} e|\}$。
statement.en: For $p \ge 1$, $u_p/p \ge 2\log\rho - |s||\operatorname{Re} e|$; including $p = 0$ gives the common lower bound $\min\{0, 2\log\rho - |s||\operatorname{Re} e|\}$.

reason.zh: 对严格正的下界取对数，把 $\log(\rho^{2p})$ 化成 $2p\log\rho$，再除以 $p$。源码在 $p = 0$ 时的商为零，所以用 $\min$ 把该项一并纳入。
reason.en: Take logarithms of the positive bound, expand $\log(\rho^{2p}) = 2p\log\rho$ and divide by $p$. The formal quotient at $p = 0$ is zero, so taking the minimum includes that term too.

title.zh: Fekete 给出偶子列的有限极限
title.en: Fekete yields a finite limit for the even subsequence

given.zh: $u_p = \log Z_c(2p)$ 次可加，且 $u_p/p$ 在实数中有下界。
given.en: The sequence $u_p = \log Z_c(2p)$ is subadditive and $u_p/p$ is bounded below in $\mathbb{R}$.

claim.zh: 存在有限 $A \in \mathbb{R}$ 使 $u_p/p \to A$，因此 $b_{2p} = \log Z_c(2p)/(2p) \to A/2$。
claim.en: There is a finite $A \in \mathbb{R}$ with $u_p/p \to A$, and therefore $b_{2p} = \log Z_c(2p)/(2p) \to A/2$.

statement.zh: $u_{p+q} \le u_p + u_q$，且 $\{u_p/p : p \in \mathbb{N}\}$ 在 $\mathbb{R}$ 中有下界。
statement.en: $u_{p+q} \le u_p + u_q$ and $\{u_p/p : p \in \mathbb{N}\}$ is bounded below in $\mathbb{R}$.

reason.zh: 把偶数长度的乘积上界与 spine 的对数下界并在一起，恰好得到源码 Fekete 引理需要的两个假设。
reason.en: The even-length product bound and the spine logarithmic bound supply exactly the two hypotheses of the Fekete lemma used in the source.

statement.en: Consequently there is $A \in \mathbb{R}$ such that $u_p/p \to A$.

reason.zh: 次可加性给出归一化极限，下界排除向负无穷发散；$u_1$ 本身有限又提供有限上界。
reason.en: Subadditivity gives the normalized limit. The lower bound rules out divergence to minus infinity, while the finite value $u_1$ supplies a finite upper bound.

reason.zh: Fekete 除的是指标 $p$，题目除的是实际步数 $2p$；这一个二倍尺度必须保留到极限中。
reason.en: Fekete divides by the index $p$, whereas the target divides by the actual length $2p$. The factor of two must therefore remain in the limit.

title.zh: 用单步代价夹住每个奇数长度
title.en: Squeeze odd lengths using a fixed one-step cost

given.zh: 取 $M = \max\{Z_{\mathrm{up}}(1), Z_{\mathrm{down}}(1)\} > 0$，$C = \log M$。拆分不等式给出 $Z_c(2p+1) \le Z_c(2p) M$ 及 $Z_c(2p+2) \le Z_c(2p+1) M$。
given.en: Set $M = \max\{Z_{\mathrm{up}}(1), Z_{\mathrm{down}}(1)\} > 0$ and $C = \log M$. Splitting gives $Z_c(2p+1) \le Z_c(2p) M$ and $Z_c(2p+2) \le Z_c(2p+1) M$.

statement.en: $Z_c(2p+1) \le Z_c(2p) M$ and $Z_c(2p+2) \le Z_c(2p+1) M$.

reason.zh: 在拆分上界中把后段长度固定为一；分别从偶数长度和奇数长度拆出这一步。$M > 0$ 是两类一步配分和的最大值。
reason.en: Fix suffix length one in the split bound, once after an even prefix and once after an odd prefix. The positive $M$ is the maximum of the two one-step partition sums.

statement.zh: $\log Z_c(2p+2) - C \le \log Z_c(2p+1) \le \log Z_c(2p) + C$，其中 $C = \log M$。
statement.en: $\log Z_c(2p+2) - C \le \log Z_c(2p+1) \le \log Z_c(2p) + C$, with $C = \log M$.

reason.zh: 各配分和为正，可以取对数。左界来自第二条不等式移项；$C$ 无须假设非负。
reason.en: Positivity permits taking logarithms. Rearranging the second inequality gives the lower bound; $C$ need not be nonnegative.

statement.en: Divide by $2p+1$: $b_{2p+2} \cdot \frac{2p+2}{2p+1} - \frac{C}{2p+1} \le b_{2p+1} \le b_{2p} \cdot \frac{2p}{2p+1} + \frac{C}{2p+1}$.

reason.zh: 分母严格为正，不等号方向保持；把两侧的对数分别改写成偶数长度的归一化值。
reason.en: The denominator is positive, preserving both inequalities. Rewrite the two outer logarithms as their normalized even-length values.

statement.zh: 两侧都趋于 $A/2$，因为两个比值 $\to 1$、$C/(2p+1) \to 0$；故 $b_{2p+1} \to A/2$。
statement.en: Both outer expressions tend to $A/2$: the ratios tend to $1$ and $C/(2p+1)$ tends to $0$. Hence $b_{2p+1} \to A/2$.

reason.zh: $b_{2p}$ 与其移位 $b_{2p+2}$ 具有相同极限。将上下界夹到一起，就补上了偶数子列没有覆盖的全部奇数长度。
reason.en: The even subsequence and its one-index shift have the same limit. The squeeze theorem therefore supplies all the odd lengths missing from the even subsequence.

title.zh: 合并奇偶，再回到任意起点
title.en: Combine parities and return to any starting point

given.zh: 对每个标准起点 $c$，$b_{2p}$ 与 $b_{2p+1}$ 都趋于其对应的 $A/2$；任意 $o$ 与其中一个 $c$ 同类。
given.en: For each representative $c$, both $b_{2p}$ and $b_{2p+1}$ tend to its corresponding $A/2$. Every $o$ belongs to one of the two classes.

claim.zh: $\log Z_o(n)/n$ 在全部自然数长度上收敛，并且极限就是定义中的 $\mathrm{freeEnergy}(o, e, s)$。
claim.en: The full sequence $\log Z_o(n)/n$ converges, and its limit is exactly the defined $\mathrm{freeEnergy}(o, e, s)$.

statement.zh: 给定 $\varepsilon > 0$，分别取 $P_0$、$P_1$，使 $p \ge P_0$ 时 $|b_{2p} - A/2| < \varepsilon$，$p \ge P_1$ 时 $|b_{2p+1} - A/2| < \varepsilon$。
statement.en: Given $\varepsilon > 0$, choose $P_0$ and $P_1$ so the even error is below $\varepsilon$ for $p \ge P_0$ and the odd error is below $\varepsilon$ for $p \ge P_1$.

reason.zh: 这是两条子列收敛的定义；它们进入同一个极限 $A/2$ 的邻域，但可以有不同的进入时间。
reason.en: This is convergence of the two subsequences. They approach the same $A/2$ neighbourhood, possibly after different thresholds.

statement.zh: 令 $P = \max\{P_0, P_1\}$。$n \ge 2P$ 时写成 $n = 2p$ 或 $n = 2p+1$，均有 $p \ge P$。
statement.en: Set $P = \max\{P_0, P_1\}$. For $n \ge 2P$, write $n = 2p$ or $n = 2p+1$; in either case $p \ge P$.

reason.zh: 自然数的奇偶分解覆盖全部 $n$，因此两条子列的共同尾部控制整个序列的尾部。
reason.en: The parity decomposition covers every natural number, so their common tails control the entire sequence tail.

statement.zh: 若 $o$ 与标准起点 $c$ 同类，则 $\log Z_o(n)/n = \log Z_c(n)/n \to A_c/2$。
statement.en: If $o$ and representative $c$ have the same class, $\log Z_o(n)/n = \log Z_c(n)/n \to A_c/2$.

reason.zh: 同类平移给出逐项相等，所以收敛直接传回 $o$。$A_c$ 可以依赖起点类别，这里不需要比较两类极限。
reason.en: Translation gives termwise equality and transfers convergence to $o$. The value $A_c$ may depend on the starting class; no comparison of the two class limits is required.

statement.zh: 该序列既然趋于实数极限，其 limUnder 就等于这个极限，即 $\mathrm{freeEnergy}(o, e, s)$。
statement.en: Since the sequence has a real limit, its limUnder equals that limit, namely $\mathrm{freeEnergy}(o, e, s)$.

reason.zh: 最后才使用 freeEnergy 的定义识别极限值；没有在收敛证明之前假定 limUnder 自动具有极限性质。
reason.en: Only after proving convergence do we identify the limit using the definition of freeEnergy; the definition of limUnder alone was not used as a convergence claim.
